notes.content:

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.15
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
I thought the last update would be the last before beta, but plans may be changing [b]slightly[/b]. I'll keep you informed about what's going on when I have plans finalized. There's still spots left for the beta, and if you sign up soon, you'll be guaranteed a spot! You can sign up here: [url=https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/]https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/[/url]

These patch notes may be short, but there's so much more behind the scenes that I'm not adding to these notes, and I can't wait for you to be able to experience all that the game has to offer.

[h3]Features[/h3][list]
[*] Pause menu during battle. Finally.
[*] Improved UI during battle.
[*] Improved feedback form. Now you can choose to send your save file and/or screenshot with your report.
[*] Cutscene text reveal speed setting.[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Challenge mode has been crunched down from 10 total stages to 5. This reduces a bit of tedium, and gives it a more challenging difficulty curve.[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] Loot chest rebalancing. Overall reducing the amount of gold and knowledge, but adding some gears.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a condition where certain ability slots could no longer be used during battle.
[*] Fixed some conditions where you could click through traps and trigger other events with the same click.
[*] Fixed some terrain and camera issues.
[*] General UI fixes, optimizations, and layering fixes.[/list]

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
I just want to thank you for your time and support. I hope you enjoy playing Heroes Suck.

Thanks for playing!
Kalradia

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.14
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
A lot of work has been put into this update. So much that I don't have patch notes, but I do have bullet points of new content. This is the last update before beta, so if you would like to get a spot in the beta test, please do sign up. There's still spots left, and if you sign up soon, you'll be guaranteed a spot! You can sign up here: [url=https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/]https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/[/url]

[h3]Features[/h3][list]
[*] Voice acting! Kaelviir now has voice lines that play as you interact with the game.
[*] Heroes now have a gearing system. As they level up, their gear will improve.
[*] All new music. Experience the new and improved soundtrack.
[*] All new building upgrade system. You can experience this by upgrading the forge. The demo is limited to level 2, but in the full game each building will have 5 levels.[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Skipping cutscenes now shows a summary.
[*] NUMEROUS optimizations. Seriously, a lot of things were done in this regard. There's still a lot more to do. Visit the graphics settings menu if you'd like to tweak the settings to your liking.
[*] Various QoL improvements were added. Including pre-selecting an ability before it comes off cooldown.[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] Removal of damage ranges, now everything deals a flat amount of damage. This means less RNG.
[*] Challenge boss loot chests have been balanced to drop less often, but give more rewards, proportionally.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Rare soft lock conditions have been squashed.
[*] So many more...[/list]

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
I just want to thank you for your time and support. This project has been going on for longer than I anticipated, but it's getting closer and closer to release.

Thanks for playing!
Kalradia

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.8
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
It's been a while! I've been making new content, and QoL changes. I figured it's time to update the demo. Here's the deal, though. I recently moved, things have been chaotic. I've also transitioned to a new source control, so I lost some history. As such, these patch notes are probably incomplete. I put in as much as I could remember, but I vaguely recall rebalancing quite a few things, especially challenge mode. Anyway, I hope you enjoy the update! Here's what I remember...

[h3]Features[/h3][list]
[*] New trap: Arrow Rain. This replaces Time Warper. This may only be a temporary change, we'll see. I wanted to give you a new trap to try out!
[*] Defeat rewards! Sounds crazy, I know. Now you'll keep 20% of the gold and experience, and all of the loot dropped upon a defeat.
[*] New Forge UI.[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Mastery expansion and cleanup! I've added a lot of QoL to the mastery trees, and added a whole new one in this update. I'll let you see for yourself. [i]Btw, I also added a hotkey to preview the max level.[/i]
[*] Flame Jet now has 2 new attach points.
[*] New descriptions for various items.
[*] Replaced some icons with newer ones. Most notably, "Battle" is now "Defend".
[*] Lightning pylon now attaches to the ceiling.
[*] Traps now show fortitude damage.
[*] Added a new UI element for hero fortitude. (It's the yellow bar under their health.)[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] Added a cooldown to the pendulum axe, which can be removed again with enough upgrades. This trap felt a little too strong early game, but it can scale back up to how it was in the mid game.
[*] Loot chests now have a [b]greatly[/b] reduced drop rate, but have rewards increased to compensate. Overall, chests should feel less burdensome and a heck of a lot more rewarding. But there's still RNG, so no guarantees![/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] I think I fixed a bug related to stacking traps - but I can't remember anymore. Please let me know if you're still able to stack them.
[*] Fixed discrepancies with the functionality of the "Esc" button. Again, please let me know if you notice anything out of the ordinary.[/list]

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
I just want to thank you for your time and support. It means a lot to me as I endeavor to start a tiny studio that makes high quality gaming content for you! If you're interested in beta, [url=https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/]sign up to the newsletter[/url] for your opportunity to join the upcoming test.

Thanks for playing!
Kalradia


[i]PS: If you [url=https://discord.gg/wDez7ewb2f]join discord[/url] and ask nicely enough, I just may add more challenge mode stages for you to enjoy.[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.7.3
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
Optimizations and improvements! Physics should feel more smooth now, and the game should run faster.

[h3]Features[/h3][list]
[*] Fortitude: Heroes now have a fortitude value that must be depleted to knock them down. This value and fortitude damage each trap does will be displayed on the UI in a future update.
[*] Ability tooltips! Hover over an ability to see more information.
[*] Graphics options! A few options have been added to customize the visuals and get a bit more performance on lower end machines. More to come![/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Doubled the physics framerate from 50 to 100. This provides more accurate physics simulations at the cost of a little bit more CPU usage.
[*] Changed navmesh to allow enemies to get closer to the walls. This was initially put in place to have heroes avoid corners a bit more, but with more traps coming it will be less of an issue. This was also causing heroes to teleport around after they regained balance.
[*] Adjusted selection colliders on flame jet and pendulum axe to be a bit smaller.[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] The Pendulum Axe was previously (intentionally) ignoring some collisions if they weren't strong enough, and also ramping damage based on the impact. This logic has been removed, so the pendulum axe should now feel more consistent and powerful.
[*] The settings menu UI/UX has been improved.[/list]
[h3]Optimizations[/h3][list]
[*] Exterior environment has been optimized. Grass shadows have been removed, and meshes have been combined, with the removal of geometry that is not visible.
[*] LOD (Level of detail - essentially varying quality meshes of a particular asset) has been removed on foliage and instead been changed to use different LODs based on the graphical setting. Medium is now the default grass detail setting, since it is the heaviest on performance.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a trap trigger bug that would reset the internal delay for activating the trap.
[*] Fixed a soft lock when starting a stage after unlocking powers and having guides disabled.
[*] Fixed a shader issue with certain traps fading out at the wrong angles.
[*] Enemy health bars don't jump around as much when taking damage now.
[*] Fixed a bug that was temporarily allowing two traps to be placed on a tile.
[*] Some environment display issues have been resolved.
[*] Resolved error spam when disabling a trap selection while it is changing position.[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
I'm continuing to refine the core gameplay experience, optimizing and polishing. Content creation is also under way for beta. Spots will be limited, so be sure to [url=https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/]sign up to the newsletter[/url] for your opportunity to join the upcoming test.

Thanks for playing!
Kalradia

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.7.2
notes.content:
[h2]Important Note[/h2]
If you have any Pendulum Axes placed down in a save, you should sell them and rebuild them. They received a major overhaul in this update.

[h1]Summary[/h1]
The Pendulum Axe has been reworked. This trap was the least used trap - for a good reason. It wasn't reliable, and rarely felt like it was hitting when it mattered. It has been overhauled to intentionally strike at enemies as they pass by. Overall, it feels a lot better and more in line with the other traps. I would love to hear your feedback on the changes to this trap.

[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Pendulum Axe rework!
[*] Oh.. and the Pendulum Axe also received a visual and audible upgrade.
[*] Analytics events improvements.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed text color display issue when you have an amount of gold equal to the required amount.
[*] Fixed display issue for the dungeon level tooltip on resolutions other than 1920x1080.[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
I'm continuing to refine the core game, and beginning content creation for beta. Spots will be limited for the beta, so be sure to [url=https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/]sign up to the newsletter[/url] for your opportunity to join the upcoming test.

I really, really appreciate all of the feedback I've been receiving lately. Please, keep it coming! I'm motivated to work harder when I see people playing and enjoying the game.

Warm Regards,
Kalradia

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.7
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
This patch is focused on completing the core game loop and adding more varied gameplay. The new challenge mode will be the home of the hardest content the game has to offer, but also the most rewarding.

[h3]Features[/h3][list]
[*] Challenge mode - 5 new challenging stages with randomized waves of enemies. You may even face a new boss in this mode!
[*] Loot chests - earn them by defeating bosses in challenge mode.
[*] Town building: Forge
[*] Trap tier improvements: use Kaelviir's forge to improve traps to tier II.[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Added new resources: Gear, Scroll, Loot Chest.
[*] Removed resources: Stone, Wood. They initially were going to have a use, but the design has changed and they are no longer needed.
[*] Item descriptions now show on the tooltip when hovering over an item on various interfaces.
[*] Trap upgrade cost now shows in red if you don't have enough gold.
[*] Enabled enemy damage when hitting environment while ragdolled.
[*] Improved and optimized hero pathfinding. The game feels a little more challenging now because the heroes are better at avoiding each other.[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] Flame Jet now has a cooldown upgrade at the base tier.
[*] Lightning Pylon starts with 1 less bounce. You can purchase the bounce back as an upgrade. This trap felt a little too powerful, so the extra investment should make it feel more balanced while still allowing it to be just as strong with proper investment.
[*] Greatly reduced drop chance of loot from heroes. From 15% down to 7.5%. The new challenge mode is now the main source of loot.
[*] Reduced level scaling on gold drops.
[*] The gold cost of rank 4 of trap base damage has been slightly reduced on all traps.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Critical: Resolved an issue where trap upgrade data was lost when loading a save after closing it for the first time. This caused all trap upgrade data to be lost any time you closed the game after the first playthrough. Yikes.
[*] Time Warper now slows by the correct value. Previously it was slowing by 20% instead of the stated 25%.
[*] The cursor can sometimes get stuck in the 'holding' state. One known case was resolved. More edge cases are on the large.[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
Now that the game loop is completed, it's time to refine and begin preparing for beta! Spots will be limited for the beta, so be sure to [url=https://heroessuck.com/newsletter/]sign up to the newsletter[/url] for your opportunity to join the test.

Enjoy!
- Kalradia

notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
A batch of QoL adjustments, and some balancing changes. The highlight of this update is the new button to speed up battles.

[h3]Additions[/h3][list]
[*] Fast forward toggle for battles.
[*] New guides: 'Trap Upgrades', and 'Mastery'.
[*] New cutscene: 'Mastery' - viewed when first opening the Mastery window.[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Boss enemies have had their health increased.
[*] Hard mode difficulty and rewards have been doubled. Previously, the challenge wasn't really felt too much. This should make it more apparent.
[*] Minor UI layout adjustment on story battle selection.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Dialog typo fixes.
[*] Guides are now ordered properly when reviewed in the menu.[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
I've been working hard on the new game mode, 'Challenge'. I'm finalizing the new feature now and it should be available in the coming weeks. In this game mode you will face randomized waves of enemies with bosses. It has a greater risk, but also comes with greater reward.

Enjoy!
- Kalradia

notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.content:
I have good news and even more good news!

[h1]The demo is now available![/h1]

Firstly, thank you for bearing with me while I put the finishing touches on the demo. Now, onto the other good news. I have decided to expand the demo with some more content that will be coming in v0.7, so stay tuned for that. You can expect a whole new game mode that's designed to be more challenging and rewarding than the story mode. Along with this, I will likely unlock the forge for use in improving your traps to face the new challenges.

Regardless, hop into the demo and give it a try! I really look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback, it puts fuel in me.

If you haven't already, please do follow and wishlist the game. You can even join the community on discord if you're feeling up for it! [url=https://discord.gg/wDez7ewb2f]https://discord.gg/wDez7ewb2f[/url]

Regards,
Austin
